# Compressed_Glass_Network

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A disordered atomic network subjected to high pressure, where local structural rearrangements lead to emergent collective behavior. Serves as a physical reservoir where pressure-induced structural changes can encode information, relevant for in-materia computing.
